About

Riverside Climbing Gym opened in a converted warehouse by the river in 2015. Two friends who were tired of driving an hour to the nearest wall built the first twenty routes by hand over one long winter.

Today the gym has a forty-foot lead wall, a bouldering cave, a kids' area and a small cafe. Route setters change a third of the problems every week, so there is always something new to try.

We run beginner classes every evening, a youth team, and a women's climbing night on Thursdays. Staff are certified by the national climbing association and first-aid trained.

The gym is open seven days a week. Day passes, ten-visit cards and monthly memberships are sold at the front desk, and shoes and harnesses can be rented for a few dollars.
